title: Acuity Scheduling: Send visitors directly to a full-feature Professional-plan 14-day trial, with card entry needed to continue using the paid plan.

change.control: Primary CTA sends visitors to an unlimited-duration free account with limited features; upgrades require account settings.
change.variant: Send visitors directly to a full-feature Professional-plan 14-day trial, with card entry needed to continue using the paid plan.

quote: The variation increased the sign-ups for paid Professional accounts by 268.14% with a 99.99% chance to beat the original.
notes: Professional plan was $10/month. Premium-plan signups rose 77.78% but that secondary result was not statistically significant.

verification_details.reason: company, lift and supporting quote confirmed; not a statistical replication
